items.title: What is the main goal of Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs)?
items.content: The primary objective of ANNs is to learn from data by identifying patterns, making predictions, or taking actions based on input.

items.title: What does Backpropagation use to train ANNs?
items.content: Backpropagation uses the error between predicted and actual outputs to minimize the difference between them, thereby adjusting weights and biases in the ANN.

items.title: What type of layers are used in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs)?
items.content: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) employ convolutional and pooling layers to extract features from data, particularly images and videos.

items.title: How do Activation Functions introduce non-linearity in ANNs?
items.content: Activation functions, such as ReLU or Sigmoid, introduce non-linearity into ANN inputs by applying a mathematical transformation that allows the model to learn complex relationships.

items.title: What is Batch Normalization used for?
items.content: Batch Normalization standardizes input data for each layer, enhancing stability and speed during training by normalizing the distribution of activations across different samples.
